_doc: Channels the system watches. odedsvr runs in live-loop.yml (state/). Others run in live-loop-channel.yml with their own state dir. yt = which YouTube channel the drafts go to (main = ODED HIGHLIGHTS secrets YT_*, en = the English channel secrets YT2_*). The English channel (yt=en) is called WORLD CLIPS (owner, 17 Nov): Kai Cenat / N3on reactions and clips go ONLY there, never to ODED HIGHLIGHTS. Nothing is uploaded there until the owner connects it (YT2_* secrets).
